name: @w6w-apps/tiktok-lead-generation
description: Read Instant Form and direct-message leads from TikTok's Business API — the Lead Generation surface of the Marketing API.

w6w.longDescription:
TikTok Lead Generation reads the leads collected through TikTok's Instant Form ads and direct-message lead ads, via the Lead Generation surface of TikTok's Business (Marketing) API — distinct from the general TikTok Ads/Marketing API surface (campaign, ad group and ad management), which this app deliberately does not cover.

The app exposes only what could be independently confirmed as real, live endpoints on `business-api.tiktok.com`: fetching a single Instant Form or direct-message lead, reading the field schema of a form, fetching a lead captured through an organic TikTok Page, and bulk-downloading a Page's leads. TikTok's own documentation portal renders every endpoint page client-side from an internal, non-public API, so the exact request/response field names beyond the universal `advertiser_id` / `filtering` / `page` / `page_size` convention used across the whole Marketing API could not be fetched — see the README for exactly what was verified, how, and what was deliberately left out rather than guessed.
